name: session_pipeline_unlabeled_native_parity_v1
dataset: LibEMG Electrode Shift eight-channel 200Hz source subject 15
long_term_source: subject 15 training domain, all 25 native trials
session_calibration: subject 15 trial_1 domain, repetition R_0, one native trial per five classes including Rest
evaluation: subject 15 trial_1 domain, repetition R_1, five disjoint native trials
comparison: Fit the source and session state once; compare all six branch/two-family native trial probabilities from unlabeled evaluation with the offline labelled wrapper, and with the same wrapper given deliberately wrong but trial-consistent labels. Check source/session byte immutability and identity partitions. No target labels enter the unlabeled path.
boundary: API parity and leakage guard only, not a new classifier accuracy result, physical session change, independent subject test or live device validation.
